name: ToolMate Customer Insights
author: toolmatelabs

sections.description:
ToolMate Customer Insights helps WooCommerce stores understand what visitors actually do before they buy — or leave.

See customer journeys, products viewed, engagement, traffic sources and cart activity directly inside WordPress. Customer Insights separates meaningful shopping activity from low-signal traffic so you can focus on visitors and carts that actually matter.

Understand the customer journey

Follow meaningful visitor activity from arrival to product discovery, cart activity and purchase.

Customer Insights can show:

  • Traffic source and landing page
  • Pages and products viewed
  • Click and scroll activity
  • Visit duration and active browsing time
  • Cart activity and cart value
  • Campaign information when available
  • Individual customer journeys
  • Behavioral interest signals

Instead of treating every recorded session as equally important, Customer Insights helps separate useful visitor activity from low-signal traffic.

Identify meaningful carts

Not every recorded cart represents the same level of purchase intent.

Customer Insights evaluates available visitor and cart signals to help you understand which carts appear meaningful and which may simply be technical or low-signal activity.

Depending on the available data, you can see:

  • Products in the cart
  • Cart value and number of items
  • Pages and products viewed
  • Active browsing time
  • Scroll activity
  • Traffic source
  • Visitor signals
  • Whether a recovery email can be sent

This turns raw WooCommerce activity into information that is easier to understand and act on.

Recover abandoned sales

Abandoned cart and abandoned order recovery are included directly in Customer Insights Free.

When an eligible cart can be contacted, recovery emails can be sent manually or automatically after a configurable delay.

Recovery tools include:

  • Abandoned cart recovery
  • Abandoned order recovery
  • Automatic sending controls
  • Configurable sending delays
  • Manual recovery email sending
  • Custom subject, headline and message
  • Custom recovery button text
  • Sender name and email settings
  • Brand logo support
  • Multiple built-in email themes
  • Email preview
  • Optional recovery email open tracking

Automatic recovery is controlled by the administrator and can remain disabled until the store is ready to use it.

Recovery Email Studio

Customize recovery emails directly inside WordPress without building an email template from scratch.

Choose an included theme, add your branding, customize the recovery message and preview the customer-facing email before automatic recovery is enabled.

Analyze your WooCommerce funnel

The Analysis Center turns recorded store activity into a simple daily funnel showing the relationship between:

  1. Visitors recorded
  2. Visitors showing meaningful signals
  3. Real cart opportunities
  4. Contactable carts
  5. WooCommerce orders

Raw CSV export is also available when you want to inspect or analyze the underlying data yourself.

Built for WooCommerce

Customer Insights runs inside WordPress and is designed specifically around WooCommerce visitor, cart and order activity.

No separate analytics dashboard is required to view your Customer Insights data.

Privacy controls

Customer Insights includes controls intended to help store owners manage how visitor and recovery information is handled.

Recovery email open tracking is optional and disabled by default.

Privacy and data protection requirements vary by website, jurisdiction and configuration. Installing Customer Insights does not by itself make a website compliant with GDPR or other privacy regulations.

Site owners remain responsible for configuring their website, privacy notices, consent mechanisms and data handling appropriately.

Customer Insights Pro

Customer Insights Free contains the core visitor journey, cart intelligence and recovery functionality described above.

Customer Insights Pro is a separate plugin for stores that want additional journey insights, reporting and store intelligence.

Information about Pro is shown contextually inside Customer Insights’ own admin pages and does not replace or disable functionality included in Free.

Learn more at ToolMateLabs.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the toolmate-customer-insights folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Activate ToolMate Customer Insights through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  4. Open the Customer Insights menu in WordPress admin.
  5. Review the available settings before enabling automatic recovery emails.

Customer Insights begins collecting applicable first-party visitor and WooCommerce activity after activation. Historical visitor journeys from before installation are not reconstructed.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. ToolMate Customer Insights is designed specifically for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce.

Does Customer Insights track customer journeys?

Yes. Customer Insights records applicable first-party visitor activity and connects meaningful events into individual journeys.

Depending on the activity available, a journey can include pages viewed, products viewed, clicks, scroll activity, active time, cart activity, traffic source and other relevant signals.

Can I see anonymous visitors?

Yes. Customer Insights can record anonymous visitor activity before a visitor becomes identifiable.

Anonymous journeys remain anonymous unless information becomes available through applicable WooCommerce activity or another supported interaction.

Does every visitor become a customer record?

No.

Customer Insights is specifically designed to avoid treating every recorded session as a meaningful customer.

Low-signal or technical activity can be separated from normal visitor and journey views so store owners can focus on more useful activity.

Can Customer Insights recover abandoned carts?

Yes.

Customer Insights Free includes abandoned cart and abandoned order recovery functionality.

Eligible recovery emails can be sent manually or automatically when automatic recovery has been enabled by the administrator.

Can I customize the recovery emails?

Yes.

Recovery Email Studio includes built-in themes and controls for branding, sender information, subject, headline, message, recovery button text and sending delay.

You can preview the customer-facing email before using automatic recovery.

Does Customer Insights automatically send emails after installation?

No.

Automatic recovery sending is controlled by the administrator and must be explicitly enabled.

Does the plugin track recovery email opens?

Only if you enable that option.

Recovery email open tracking uses a 1×1 image and is disabled by default.

Does Customer Insights use Google Analytics?

Customer Insights does not require Google Analytics to display its own first-party visitor journey data inside WordPress.

Traffic and campaign information may be recorded when those signals are available to the website.

Can I see where visitors came from?

When the information is available, Customer Insights can show source, referrer, landing-page and campaign information.

Search engines and other platforms may intentionally withhold some information. For example, Google commonly does not expose the exact organic search query.

Does Customer Insights record advertising click IDs?

When present in applicable visitor traffic, Customer Insights can retain attribution signals such as GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID and FBCLID.

Availability depends on the incoming visit and the information supplied to the website.

Does installing Customer Insights make my site GDPR compliant?

No plugin can automatically make a website compliant simply by being installed.

Customer Insights provides privacy-related controls, but site owners remain responsible for their privacy notices, consent configuration, lawful basis, retention practices and other requirements applicable to their website and jurisdiction.

What is Customer Insights Pro?

Customer Insights Pro is a separate plugin that adds additional journey insights, reporting and store intelligence.

The Free plugin includes the core customer journey, cart intelligence and recovery functionality described on this page.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • Improved Visitors & Journeys interface and visitor activity overview.
  • Improved customer journey presentation and behavioral signals.
  • Improved cart classification and real-cart visibility.
  • Added and improved abandoned cart recovery functionality.
  • Added abandoned order recovery functionality.
  • Added manual recovery email sending.
  • Added configurable automatic recovery controls.
  • Added Recovery Email Studio with multiple built-in themes.
  • Added recovery email branding and content controls.
  • Added recovery email preview.
  • Added optional recovery email open tracking.
  • Added Analysis Center with daily customer funnel.
  • Added raw CSV export for analysis data.
  • Improved traffic source, referrer and landing-page information.
  • Improved campaign and advertising attribution visibility when available.
  • Improved privacy controls and related information.
  • General usability, reliability and compatibility improvements.
